mount-oneOf-80.basis: One branch form mount per session.

mount-flat-1000.basis: One flat form mount per session.

mount-nested-d6-f4.basis: One nested form mount per session.

single-flat-1000-subscribed.basis: Typing with subscribers is the most frequent input event.

leaf-gate-250.basis: Common leaf edits near a modest gate set.

leaf-gate-1000.basis: Leaf edits with a larger gate set occur less often.

leaf-gate-4000.basis: Very large gate forms are uncommon.

wave-1000.basis: One write reaching one thousand subscribers is rare.

switch-if-80.basis: Checkbox and selector changes commonly reveal if-then sections.

switch-oneOf-80.basis: A user changes a branch selector.

switch-siblings-0.basis: A branch selector changes without passive siblings.

switch-discriminator-80.basis: Tagged branch transitions are less frequent.

switch-payload-12.basis: Large payload branch transitions are less frequent.

switch-siblings-100.basis: Transitions with moderate passive siblings are less frequent.

switch-siblings-1000.basis: Transitions with one thousand siblings are exceptional.

switch-siblings-4000.basis: Transitions with four thousand siblings are extreme.

bulk-flat-2000.basis: Programmatic bulk setValue or reset is rare.

bulk-nested-d6-f4.basis: Programmatic nested bulk setValue or reset is rare.
